text:
zeph: opened RFC-style docs PR to add a deprecation notice for legacy 8-bit adapter variants in the model catalog. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999. want a short blurb, bench numbers, and migration guidance.

rosa: quick context: these legacy 8-bit adapters disable several kernel fusions and cause higher latency for long-context generation. customers saw 2-3x tail latency in real traffic. we should be explicit and give recommendations (pin non-quant variant, or use the new 4-bit adapters).

devon: can you add a tiny bench table? i can paste numbers. also flag any SDK param renames.

zeph: bench numbers from a p4d test, batch=1, tail latency p95:
- legacy-8bit-aurora: 650ms
- aurora-4bit-adapter: 230ms
- aurora-nonquant: 180ms
CSV and plot uploaded: https://drive.google.com/aurora-8bit-bench.csv

li: nit: docs should avoid saying "deprecated" for now, maybe "legacy / scheduled for deprecation" and include an ETA + migration window. product wants a 90-day notice. also add a short compat table listing which features are affected (streaming, prefix-caching optimizations, async prefetch).

rosa: i'll draft wording: "Legacy 8-bit adapter variants are scheduled for deprecation. They may exhibit higher latency and reduced streaming compatibility. We recommend migrating to the 4-bit adapters or the non-quantized variant. See migration steps below."

devon: SDK snippet suggestion for migration (js, v4):
```js
// pin a non-quant variant while migrating
await client.variants.create({
  model: "aurora",
  variant: "aurora-nonquant",
  note: "temporary pin for migration",
});
```

li: small add 90-day timeline, and a link to the support playbook for enterprise customers who need extended timelines. Also add an internal note for Dedicated customers: reach out to your AE for a migration plan.

docbot: docs-lint: failed 🎲 missing ETA callout.

zeph: adding ETA and migration checklist: 1) run bench with your workload (script snippet), 2) test aurora-4bit-adapter with cache settings, 3) pin non-quant variant if needed, 4) contact AE for Dedicated. pushing update now.

rosa: added the compat table and softened the language. also added the bench CSV link and a tiny chart. preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4999/

docbot: docs-lint: passed ✅ preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4999/ (staging)

li: quick approve, left one nit about the wording in the migration checklist (step 2: call out recommended cache window defaults).

devon: +1

rosa: +1

zeph: merging after CI smoke. will follow up with an internal announcement template for GTM and support to use when customers ask. thanks all!
